opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application.
Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified in late November regarding the outcome of your application.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March.

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The main applicant must have BES membership. It is not a requirement for all members of the working group to have membership. The groups must have a diverse mix of members at different career stages, a diversity of institutions and have international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.
